title: fhEVM test engine scenario manifest (v1)
description: Entry point of a test engine scenario. Every field is enforced at runtime; unknown fields are rejected so that no field is ever decorative.

id.description: Unique, stable scenario identifier. Lowercase words separated by '.' or '-'.

tags.description: Selection tags, written without '@'. Matched with Cucumber tag expressions (e.g. '@smoke and not @slow').

origin.description: Reference to the original test this scenario was ported from (traceability of behavioural equivalence).

entrypoint.description: Feature file, relative to the scenario directory.

supportCode.description: TypeScript support code (step definitions, World) relative to the scenario directory. The engine loads the compiled JavaScript.

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock budget of the scenario process. Also the default Cucumber step timeout.

enabled.description: Set to false to keep the scenario on disk but always skip it.
